verdict.rationale: Supabase's CLI explicitly supports running the entire stack locally or in a CI environment (supabase-docs-21), and a hands-on probe confirms the CLI installs and runs headlessly via npx with no login (supabase-probe-6, supabase-probe-8). CI-specific automation guidance is also documented for MCP (PAT-based headless auth) plus telemetry opt-out env vars suited to CI (supabase-supp-mcp-agent-security, supabase-supp-telemetry-optout), and self-hosting via Docker Compose further supports headless deployment (supabase-docs-32). Missing for 10: a third-party/independent case study of Supabase CLI running inside an actual CI pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions) rather than just docs and a local probe.
